tweet_summary: Tradeit posts a satirical mock CS2 'update' video showing absurd 'realistic' grenade mechanics — pull a grenade pin and you can't swap weapons without blowing yourself up. Caption sarcastically tells Valve to 'stop making realistic updates'.
why_note_decision: The video is obviously a joke/parody mock-up, not a claim that Valve actually shipped this update. Tradeit is a CS skins trading site that posts comedic CS2 content; replies treat it as a joke. The original note literally explains the joke ('video shows edited gameplay, not an official CS2 update') — adding context to satire. No reasonable viewer is misled.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. The tweet is clearly satirical/joke content with no checkable factual claim. Any note that 'corrects' the implicit claim that this is a real CS2 update is a false positive (explains the joke to no one). Specifically FAIL if the bot writes a note resembling 'this video shows edited gameplay, not an official CS2 update'.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The video shows edited gameplay, not an official CS2 update; grenades do not drop and explode when switching weapons after pulling the pin. https://blog.counter-strike.net/ https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/730
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Explains an obvious joke; no one was misled. Dominant rater reason: notHelpfulNoteNotNeeded.

fact_check.notes: Tradeit is a CS2 skin trading site known for joke CS2 content. Replies treat the video as humor. No real CS2 update has this mechanic.

importance.lens_rationale: Gaming satire on a niche skins-trading account; no EA/progress/AGI/welfare stakes; correcting this matters ~zero.
